collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART III (41-60, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager is locked in a noisy argument with a rude bird on the roof: keep going, or make peace.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A bird has taken to sitting on (subject)'s roof every morning and making the same loud, rude noise. It sounds a lot like it's laughing at (subject.him/her). This morning (subject) went outside and made the noise back. The bird made it louder. (subject) made it louder still. This has now been going on for some time.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) and the bird are now locked in a shouting match the whole village can hear. (friend) wanders over with a cup of tea to watch. Eventually the bird flies off. (subject) declares victory. The bird comes back the next morning. The war continues.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) leaves a few seeds on the roof edge. The bird eats them, looks at (subject) for a long moment, and makes a much quieter, much politer noise. (subject) is fairly sure that was a thank you. (subject.He/She) is also fairly sure it was laughing a bit.
